name: quo-call-transcripts
description: Fetch Quo call recordings for project contacts, transcribe them with OpenAI, and write project-local call transcript and summary files.

interface.shortDescription: Turn relevant Quo calls into project notes.
interface.longDescription: Matches Quo calls against a project root PEOPLE.md dossier, downloads relevant call recordings, transcribes audio with OpenAI, and writes transcript and summary markdown files under the project root.
defaultPrompt: Transcribe the latest Quo call for this project.
Set up this project for Quo call transcript automation.
Find relevant Quo calls from PEOPLE.md and write call notes.
